description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for Claims to Land Parcels Kandawalai D/S Division, Kilinochchi District - Cad. Map No. 920046 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to ownership or possession of land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title registration, cadastral mapping, and determination of land ownership rights across multiple districts, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
